CA.rationale: No clear explicit binding of an attention/allocation condition to a named content/time in literal substrings.

COD.rationale: Content, organization and status relations are present as technical records but lack a clear explicit natural-language binding to the same referent/time per reference rules.

A.rationale: Report contains origins/represented_time metadata but no literal explicit attention-to-content linkage meeting the A definition.

C.rationale: Many explicit content labels (e.g. red/blue coordinates) appear, but a single clear perceptual-content attribute framing for the reference composite is not unambiguously bound in natural-language form here.

D.rationale: The text distinguishes origins and record kinds but does not separately attribute organization/presentation status to identified contents in the manner required for D.

O.rationale: The report lists presentation-like records and candidate/current markers, but lacks an explicit natural-language claim about how an identified content is presented/emerges/accessed per the O definition.
